[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.24.2″ custom_margin=”||51px||false|false” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Protect your home’s electrical system and appliances with Home Stand-Bys’ Home Surge Protection service. Power surges, whether from lightning strikes, utility grid switching, or electrical equipment operation, can damage your electronics and appliances. Our surge protection solutions are designed to safeguard your home against these voltage spikes, ensuring the longevity of your devices and providing you with peace of mind.

Our process begins with a comprehensive assessment of your home’s electrical system. This assessment allows us to determine the best surge protection solution tailored to your home’s specific needs. Once the assessment is complete, our experienced technicians install the surge protection system with precision and care, ensuring that it is seamlessly integrated into your home’s electrical infrastructure.

After installation, we conduct thorough testing to verify that the surge protection system is functioning correctly and providing the expected level of protection. Additionally, we offer regular maintenance services to keep your surge protection system in optimal condition, ensuring continued protection for your home.
